lines: You can highlight every line of the chapter, and still remember none of it.
When you highlight, your eyes do the work. Your brain barely has to.
So the color stays on the page, and the memory doesn't.
What actually sticks is pulling the answer out yourself, with nothing to look at.
Every time you quiz yourself, that path gets stronger.
So Unspool turns your notes into reels, and every one ends with a quiz.
Try it free, at unspool dot c c.
